name: Customer Action Requested
description:
Event requesting that a customer, user, or participant take an explicit action. This is typically emitted when an
automated workflow reaches a point that needs human review, consent, selection, confirmation, or additional input.

The event should describe the requested action in human-readable form and provide a deterministic list of allowed
actions. The response should be represented by Customer Action Responded or a domain-specific response event.

title.description: Title shown to the user or participant for the pending action.

message.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of what is being requested and why.

actions.description: Allowed action labels or structured options. Their order is the display/order preference.

label.description: User-facing action label shown in the pending action card.

variant.description: Optional button style variant. Supported values: primary | secondary | reject.

inputSchema.description: Optional input schema. If present, the selected action may collect user input.

inputRequired.description: Optional flag indicating whether input is required for this action.

inputTitle.description: Optional title displayed above the action input control.

inputPlaceholder.description: Optional placeholder/help text shown in the action input control.
